identity_generation_rules: A pageEpoch and every nonzero sessionEpoch are native-issued and strictly increase within one Bridge lifetime.
A renderer rebuild uses a new pageInstanceId; the bounded retired-page cache rejects recent reuse.
A repeated or older generation from an adapter is an INTERNAL_FAILURE and grants no authority.
completion_rules: Every accepted request has exactly one method-specific completion signal unless its page or session is invalidated.
errorCode OK requires errorArgumentIndex 0 and the exact command result object.
Any non-OK error requires a null result and never carries backend text.
Malformed or stale calls return accepted false in SubmitAck and perform no side effect.
Completion signals never contain a method name, arbitrary payload, traceback, SQL, absolute internal path, or secret outside an explicitly secret result type.

qt_webchannel_infrastructure.business_signals: method completion signals plus the seven fixed host signals
qt_webchannel_infrastructure.signature_aliases: Business signatures and deleteLater() share their canonical method index. destroyed(QObject*) shares the destroyed index; destroyed() is a distinct inherited QObject overload. None has adapter capability.
rules: QObject infrastructure is not a business command and never enters an adapter.
objectName is never read for identity, authorization, routing, logging, or diagnostics.
If Qt executes deleteLater, the native boundary closes synchronously, invalidates page and session authority, cancels in-flight work, and discards late results.
Any additional canonical inherited method, signal, or property fails the M3.3 transport gate.

adjudications.conflict: The prototype accepts an arbitrary database path string, while the production security baseline permits only fixed native file tasks.
adjudications.decision: The renderer may submit one bounded databasePathCandidate as untrusted public text, but that text is never a file capability. The native host canonicalizes it, applies the allowed-root and retained-existing-path policy, decides OPEN_EXISTING versus CREATE_NEW, and only then mints a short-lived selectionTicket. An empty candidate runs one fixed native final-path chooser that never asks the user to choose open versus create; a recentDatabaseId still resolves natively. openDatabaseV1 consumes the ticket and revalidates target identity and existence. This preserves editable/default-path startup and D1 without granting renderer file access.

adjudications.conflict: The M1 fixture keeps all decrypted records in JavaScript for filtering, duplicate grouping, health, QuickBar, and copying.
adjudications.decision: Production list, search, duplicate, health, and QuickBar operations execute under Python/core authority and return only bounded summaries. The M1 arrays, generic copyText function, and inert dispatcher are not production data or command paths.

adjudications.conflict: The prototype pre-fills both password and TOTP secret in the edit form, while the security baseline separates secret permissions and forbids returning a TOTP secret.
adjudications.decision: openRecordEditorV1 is the explicit password-edit authorization and may return one bounded password lease. It returns only hasTotp for TOTP; updateRecordV1 uses KEEP, REPLACE, or CLEAR and a replacement seed is input-only. A TOTP seed is never present in any result type.

adjudications.conflict: The prototype delete confirmation is only a renderer state transition.
adjudications.decision: D3 and D4 are enforced across the trust boundary with prepareDeleteRecordV1 or prepareDeleteNoteV1 followed by a short-lived, single-use delete ticket. For D4, the cancellable renderer confirmation exists before any ticket: only its explicit dangerous action starts the immediate C17-to-C18 chain. The final delete method accepts no renderer-supplied entity ID.

adjudications.conflict: The prototype QuickBar is a Web overlay, while M2.3 froze the production carrier as native QWidget.
adjudications.decision: openQuickbarV1 is the only Web-to-host intent. The top-bar pointer entry requires an enabled current session but does not depend on global-hotkey registration; H03 remains registration-gated. Search, copy, and generate-and-copy use the typed native QuickBar port and are not registered on QWebChannel.

adjudications.conflict: QWebChannel publishes QObject infrastructure and signature aliases in addition to product-declared slots, and static Qt slot types coerce JSON values before Python validation.
adjudications.decision: Each business argument is an individual QVariant validated without coercion against its frozen scalar type before adapter admission. The only accepted QObject infrastructure is deleteLater/deleteLater(), destroyed/destroyed(QObject*) plus the distinct destroyed() overload, and objectName. objectName is never authority; deleteLater has no adapter route and is guarded as a fail-closed lifecycle action.

decision_guards.D1: A bounded path candidate, a native chooser result, or a recentDatabaseId is resolved by native policy to a short-lived ticket; openDatabaseV1 then preserves one unified connect/create operation.
decision_guards.D2: Language is exactly ZH or EN and all errors are fixed frontend translation codes.
decision_guards.D3: Note deletion first shows a cancellable confirmation without a ticket; its explicit dangerous action immediately chains prepareDeleteNoteV1 and deleteNoteV1 with a single-use ticket.
decision_guards.D4: Password deletion shows one cancellable confirmation without minting a ticket; its explicit dangerous action immediately runs prepareDeleteRecordV1 followed by deleteRecordV1 with a single-use ticket.
decision_guards.D5: changeDatabasePasswordV1 requires currentPassword validation before any write.
decision_guards.D6: Existing records are addressed by EntityId plus Revision, and updateRecordV1 returns the same EntityId. Platform is a raw user-visible record name: create, update, and import reject only an exactly equal existing raw string, preserve case and every leading, internal, and trailing whitespace character, and reject an all-whitespace value. Account is display data rather than an identity or uniqueness key, and no auto-rename surface exists. SIMILAR is a current-vault dynamic classification whose Python key removes every str.isspace() character then applies Unicode casefold; it uses no compatibility normalization, pinyin, punctuation removal, or edit distance, requires at least two IDs, is numbered by sorted key, and is never persisted or auto-fixed.
decision_guards.D7: MasterPassword is a required string with min_chars 0 for open, switch, current-password verification, and password changes; empty is distinct from a missing, null, or wrong-type argument. This transport contract does not claim that an empty password provides user-secret entropy.
decision_guards.D8: BackupPassword has min_chars 1 and is supplied explicitly to authenticated encrypted export and import operations; no command defaults, persists, or derives it from MasterPassword.
decision_guards.D9: VaultSummary and RecordDetails expose separate updatedDate and passwordChangedDate fields. updateRecordV1 preserves passwordChangedDate on KEEP and refreshes it only when a REPLACE value actually differs from the persisted password; favorite-only updates preserve both timestamps under D9; C62 applies KEEP/REPLACE separately to each field under D22.
decision_guards.D10: openQuickbarV1 exposes only a current authenticated-session show intent for one independent top-level native QWidget. The top-bar pointer entry remains available when enabled even if global-hotkey registration is unavailable; only H03 requires REGISTERED and an actual native registration owner. Search and copy use the non-QWebChannel native QuickBar port with native session identity; this contract exposes no cross-database index, second renderer, main-window activation authority, or full-screen overlay. C44 atomically persists enabled plus a 10-600 second idle-hide policy whose default is 30 seconds.
decision_guards.D11: Only chooseDatabaseTargetV1 accepts one bounded untrusted database path candidate. Native policy resolves it to a short-lived ticket, and openDatabaseV1 consumes and revalidates that ticket; path text is never file authority.
decision_guards.D12: Record and note favorite values are Bool, and favorite writes require EntityId plus Revision. No passwordChangedDate mutation is defined; field-at-rest classification and backup integrity remain core/storage evidence rather than transport proof.
decision_guards.D13: Bootstrap returns at most five recent summaries with opaque IDs and lastUsedUnixMs, and selectRecentDatabaseV1 only converts an opaque recent ID into a ticket. security.st encryption, ordering, removal, natural-day rendering, and lock-record independence require native/core/UI evidence beyond this transport contract.
decision_guards.D14: RecordDetails exposes only hasPassword, never password length. C13 has a 30000 ms one-time delivery deadline and becomes current-location display authority after authorized emission; C08, record/view/revision changes, and native security boundaries revoke it. C19/C20 accept only EntityId plus Revision and return content-free clipboard state; known empty fields return EMPTY_FIELD, write nothing, start no countdown, and receive contextual non-success feedback without replacing the current query, results, or focus. Native standard Copy gestures may copy the exact current nonempty selection from declared password inputs in either masked or visible state via a fixed isolated-world read and the owned clipboard controller; no general renderer text-copy command is exposed.
decision_guards.D15: 工具和当前表单各持独立C33生成授权。普通同页导航、进入连接页和转入正常新增表单不清工具值；同位置新生成成功才替换旧值，表单保存或取消只清表单。各授权仍最多300000ms，锁定、切库、页面失效或退出全清，不形成历史或跨page恢复。
decision_guards.D16: Vault item names are public selectable text zones that do not activate their list or split container. Activation outside the name zone and keyboard Enter or Space retain the original typed C10/C11 selection semantics; account and password copying remains native-authoritative.
decision_guards.D17: C36 and C37 share one global native config commit order. An actual value change is atomically persisted and read back before authoritative SettingsResult and S02 publication in commit order; a same-value request performs no config write, settingsRevision change, or S02. settingsRevision is opaque, and S05 changes only the effective theme without changing that revision or emitting S02. User feedback remains fixed localized frontend presentation.
decision_guards.D18: C43 persists only TO_TRAY or EXIT and never grants renderer exit or window-hiding authority. If a native TO_TRAY close cannot establish a visible recoverable tray entry or cannot hide successfully, H01/H02 keep or restore the main window and authorized session and show a fixed localized native Exit/Cancel modal. Cancel is the focused default; Cancel, Escape, the modal close control, Alt+F4, or modal-construction failure preserve the window, session, and setting without H06. Only explicit Exit enters H06. Normal EXIT and the tray Exit action remain confirmation-free under X4.
decision_guards.D19: C47 controls only the GetLastInputInfo idle policy. H04/H06 always revoke and lock an unlocked session on Windows suspend or Modern Standby, even when C47 is disabled; resume must remain concealed until the same idempotent lock boundary is complete.
decision_guards.X1: ViewMode contains only LIST and SPLIT; no drawer command or enum exists.
decision_guards.X2: Only encrypted backup commands exist; plaintext JSON and CSV export are unrepresentable.
decision_guards.X3: No density type, setting, command, or result field exists.
decision_guards.X4: CloseBehavior is TO_TRAY or EXIT and normal native EXIT plus the tray Exit action have no confirmation command. The D18 native modal exists only to authorize EXIT as a replacement after TO_TRAY cannot be completed; it is not an EXIT confirmation surface and is never renderer-controlled.
decision_guards.X5: No URL type, field, search dimension, URL-navigation command, or external-URL-open action exists; addresses may remain ordinary note text only.
decision_guards.D21: Only the ALL vault filter uses favorite after the chosen primary sort value. Other filters do not reorder by favorite.
decision_guards.D22: 已有超限字段保持可读且未改值由原生保留，新值执行既有长度限制。按D38，新增或实际改密码时原子提交内容和待测空评级；评分后台完整执行并核对原输入后写回，失败不回滚已保存内容。
decision_guards.D20: Keyboard-visible focus remains local to the current UI scope and never grants Bridge authority. Pointer input, scope closure and native security boundaries clear the visible focus mode.
decision_guards.D23: 记事新标题上限256字符/1024字节、正文65536/262144；已有超限字段通过C63完整读取、C65 KEEP原样保留，只有替换字段才应用新上限。
decision_guards.D24: 记事收藏只更新favorite与版本；不刷新updated_at，不改变最近更新时间排序。
decision_guards.D25: 记事分类只有ALL/FAVORITE，排序由C24的独立sortMode指定UPDATED/NAME；中文标题按原生无声调拼音串、英文不区分大小写，同键按ID升序，分页游标绑定排序。
decision_guards.D26: 健康问题只使用WEAK、DUPLICATE、STALE；常见密码只进入唯一core弱密码判断，不新增类型或重复扣分。
decision_guards.D27: 引导只在当前recordId的保存成功回执后计为已处理；取消、失败和保存其他记录不计，统计不声称问题已修复。
decision_guards.D28: 仅体检单项编辑在保存成功、取消、关闭或退出键后返回发起问题卡的原页与滚动位置；保存后使用当前数据夹紧页号，普通密码库编辑和逐个引导不继承该来源。
decision_guards.D29: 生成特殊字符固定为!@#$%^&*()[]，排除0O1lI默认关闭，可在工具生成器配置区切换；C33消费统一参数，解锁后C48原子保存配置。
decision_guards.D30: C34完整分析最多1024字符/4096字节且可取消，不占业务线程。普通导航及工具标签切换保留输入、任务与结果，隐藏页完成不抢导航；新输入/清空和安全边界取消旧计算并释放资源。
decision_guards.D31: C23使用当前page授权手动清理本应用拥有的剪贴板内容；未连接生成复制仍沿用用户的清理模式，不覆盖后来由其他应用复制的内容。
decision_guards.D32: C70/C71/C72只接受当前会话的全量体检控制并返回有界非秘密计数。后台有限并发，版本检查后仅写strength，内容与时间不变；取消保留已完成结果，安全边界先回收进程再释放会话。评级不改变单条内容版本，列表和体检聚合版本仍包含评级。
decision_guards.D33: N01只返回当前已解锁库按收藏优先及名称拼音固定排序的前20条摘要并给出总数；查询受128字符/512字节限制。N02/N03空字段短提示及普通可恢复失败保留当前查询、结果、选中项和焦点，记录失效只刷新当前查询一次。N04固定四字符集和4-1024长度，生成秘密只写原生剪贴板。显示反馈绑定当前QuickBar显示代次，旧完成不得投影到重开周期。托盘视觉只区分连接与未连接：CONNECTED为绿色勾选及已连接，DISCONNECTED/LOCKED复用灰色数据库及未连接；内部安全状态不合并。普通Toast最多保留最新3条，真实隐藏暂停、恢复续跑、普通失焦不暂停，安全离开清除且不重播。
decision_guards.D34: C73只接受90、100、110、125四档UI字号比例并进入现有全局原子设置提交顺序。SettingsSnapshot始终返回规范化uiFontScale；缺失或非法旧配置回退100。网页、QuickBar、Qt自绘标题和安全幕布只消费同一权威快照；系统文件对话框仍由Windows控制。
decision_guards.D35: 离线双语帮助只读取随包资源；主界面和托盘创建前显示软件许可告知，用户可继续或退出，阅读记录写入失败不阻止继续。
decision_guards.D36: Note conflicts use normalized titles only to find candidates; explicit overwrite is bound to a stable target ID and complete snapshot. Ambiguous bulk matches remain undecided and two sources cannot overwrite one target.
decision_guards.D37: One independently resizable backup window borrows the current session. Review password conflicts before note conflicts, skip empty groups and preserve decisions on return. Bulk decisions are restricted to the explicit group; commit remains atomic across both groups. A fixed launcher delivers page/session-bound completion notifications without exposing the mutable controller.
decision_guards.D38: 记录与待测空评级原子保存，后台完整分析并核对原输入后仅写评级。失败同输入每会话自动一次，C75显式重试；未完成时scoreAvailable为false，S06更新绑定当前代次，不改变内容版本。
decision_guards.D39: 恢复码通用且仅离线保存和手动标记；不进入摘要/搜索，复制不标已用。旧库先保留原样加密副本再事务升级；旧载荷缺恢复码为空，明确整条覆盖可清空目标，新载荷严格校验。
decision_guards.D40: 密码库与快速栏的名称/账号、记事标题及设置分组/名称/说明保留原文匹配，并支持连续无声调全拼与首字母；记事正文仅原文匹配。沿用既有命令、查询限额、排序分页与授权，不新增网络、秘密摘要或持久索引。

commands.notes: A renderer rebuild always receives LOCKED and sessionEpoch 0; it never inherits an unlocked session.

A nonempty bounded candidate is canonicalized and resolved under native allowed-root and retained-existing-path policy; empty invokes one fixed native chooser. Candidate text grants no file access. The ticket expires after 300000 ms. It is consumed by success or a terminal target/lock failure; only AUTH_FAILED_RETRY_2 or AUTH_FAILED_RETRY_1 may continue the same page-bound target within the original TTL.
The renderer cannot convert a path string into a ticket. Selecting a recent item still does not connect.

The host rechecks target existence, identity, .db scope, lock state, and ticket binding. Wrong-password continuations remain bound to the same page, target, and original ticket TTL; the third failure locks the database. The master password is never echoed, logged, cached, or returned.
The old session is revoked and synchronously cleaned before a new session can be authorized. Failure leaves the application locked, never silently back in the old session.
Native request rejection, timers, clipboard, core cache, database, and key cleanup do not wait for this completion signal or JavaScript.
Cancellation addresses one request ID only. It cannot name a method or inject a payload.
Idempotent and valid for page-only generated leases or session-bound record leases. Closing or hiding a sensitive view calls this, while native lock still revokes all leases synchronously.

This exposes only the top-bar pointer show intent for an enabled current session. It does not require REGISTERED or a working global hotkey. H03 is a separate native entry and remains strictly gated by REGISTERED plus the actual native registration owner. The native QuickBar does not share a Web renderer or QWebChannel object.
conditional_rules: C09 requires quickbarEnabled true but does not require quickbarRegistration REGISTERED
H03 native hotkey activation still requires REGISTERED and an actual native registration owner

commands.notes: At most 100 summaries. Duplicate grouping, filters, search, counts, and ordering are computed under Python/core authority; no password or TOTP seed is returned.
Returns one account and notes payload after explicit selection, but no password, TOTP code, or TOTP seed.
The password lease expires within 300000 ms and is revoked on close, hide, lock, switch, page rebuild, or exit. hasTotp is returned, never the TOTP seed.

The one-time reveal result must be delivered within 30000 ms. A long password keeps that deadline through all C60 chunks and becomes current-location display authority only after the final chunk is emitted. Hiding, record/view/revision change, or a native security boundary revokes it without waiting for a timer.

conditional_rules: totpAction NONE requires an empty totpSecret
totpAction REPLACE requires a valid non-empty normalized Base32 totpSecret
platform uniqueness uses exact raw-string equality under Python/core authority and rejects only all-whitespace names
passwordAction KEEP requires an empty password argument and preserves password_changed_at
passwordAction REPLACE accepts an explicitly empty or non-empty replacement and refreshes password_changed_at only when the persisted password value actually changes
totpAction KEEP or CLEAR requires an empty totpSecret
totpAction REPLACE requires a valid non-empty normalized Base32 totpSecret
the edit lease is single-use and bound to recordId, revision, pageEpoch, and sessionEpoch
the returned item.recordId equals the input recordId; changing platform never changes entity identity
platform uniqueness uses exact raw-string equality under Python/core authority and excludes the current record ID
updatedDate reflects actual record content changes independently of passwordChangedDate; standalone favorite changes preserve updatedDate and passwordChangedDate under D9

commands.notes: favorite is a strict Bool write bound to recordId and revision; it preserves both passwordChangedDate and updatedDate under D9

C17 is called only after the user explicitly activates the dangerous button, never while the confirmation is still cancellable. The ticket expires within 60000 ms, is single-use, is passed immediately to C18 without another user step, and is destroyed by C18 admission, a late or discarded C17 completion, lock, switch, page rebuild, or exit.

No record ID is accepted at the final dangerous boundary; the server resolves the entity only from the delete ticket. The fixed frontend flow submits C18 immediately after a valid C17 completion and never retains the ticket across a cancellable UI state.
The renderer supplies only identity and revision, never arbitrary clipboard text.
Python/core resolves the password and the native host writes it. The password never enters this request or result.
Only a six-digit code and at most 30 remaining seconds are returned. The TOTP seed is never returned.

User-requested owned-content clearing is available on the current page whether locked or unlocked; it never clears content subsequently copied by another application. Lock, switch, change-key completion, and exit use the separate native force-clear boundary.
At most 100 summaries. Each content preview is capped at 160 characters; full note bodies are never batch-returned.
常规字段完整返回；超过新输入上限的已有字段只返回有界占位并列入 longFields，完整原值由 C63 读取。
D24：favorite 是严格 Bool，按 noteId 和 revision 原子写入；单独收藏或取消收藏不改变 updatedDate。

D3: show a cancellable confirmation without minting a ticket. Only the explicit dangerous action immediately chains C29 and C30; no third confirmation is added. A ticket expires within 60000 ms, is single-use, and native lock, switch, page rebuild, late-result discard, or exit revokes it.
No note ID is accepted at the final dangerous boundary; the server resolves the entity only from the delete ticket.

The stale threshold comes from validated native settings. Passwords used for scoring remain in Python/core. The response also carries the first 20 WEAK, DUPLICATE, and STALE units from the same scan and local date; all four healthRevision values match. C32 serves later pages.
At most 100 issue summaries. Weak, duplicate, and stale computation stays in Python/core; the frontend only orchestrates navigation and progress.

conditional_rules: at least one character set must be selected
length must be at least the number of selected character sets
Python secrets and SystemRandom are the only randomness authority
commands.notes: The page-bound lease expires within 300000 ms and is never persisted or cached as a completion result.

The full input, up to 1024 characters and 4096 UTF-8 bytes, is analyzed in a separate terminable process. A newer input, an explicit clear, or a security boundary cancels prior work and releases its resources. Ordinary in-page navigation preserves the current input, work, result, and selected tool tab without navigating back on completion. The result contains fixed feedback codes and bounded crack-time buckets, never localized backend strings or an echo of the password.
The page submits only the generated-secret lease ID, not arbitrary clipboard text.

C36 shares one native config commit order with every page setting write. A changed value is atomically persisted and read back before the authoritative SettingsResult and S02 publication; a same-value request performs no config write, does not change the opaque settingsRevision, and emits no S02.

C37 shares one native config commit order with every page setting write. A changed value is atomically persisted and read back before the authoritative SettingsResult and S02 publication; a same-value request performs no config write, does not change the opaque settingsRevision, and emits no S02. Dynamic product copy remains frontend-rendered from fixed translation keys; backend errors are stable codes, not localized free text.
This setting controls host-side selection of the last recentDatabaseId; it never authorizes a renderer-provided path.
Only LIST and SPLIT exist. X1 drawer and X3 density cannot be reintroduced through this contract.

C40 is a public page setting and remains available while locked with sessionEpoch 0, like C36/C37; it grants no database-session authority. The native host adopts sidebarText before renderer S02 delivery. Shrinking from x=72 to x=48 is immediately safe; widening from x=48 to x=72 remains conservatively at x=48 until the existing renderer-presentation frame proof confirms the current page and the curtain is fully hidden. The next handoff then uses x=72 without changing visible curtain geometry. A lock during the S02 or first-frame gap therefore over-covers rather than exposes content. Startup remains x=0 and no DOM measurement is authoritative.
The 5-60 second value remains validated even in MANUAL mode. Security-boundary force-clear is not configurable.

C43 shares the same global native config commit order as C36/C37. A changed close preference is atomically persisted and read back before the authoritative SettingsResult and S02 publication; a same-value request performs no config write, does not change the opaque settingsRevision, and emits no S02. C43 does not authorize the renderer to hide a window, decide tray availability, show the D18 recovery modal, or certify cleanup. Normal EXIT and tray Exit remain confirmation-free under X4. A later TO_TRAY failure is handled entirely by H01/H02: the fixed localized native Exit/Cancel modal preserves the setting on both choices, and only explicit Exit enters H06.

enabled and idleSeconds form one atomic QuickBar policy. idleSeconds is always validated in the 10-600 second range and defaults to 30 when persisted input is absent or invalid. QWebChannel admission never waits for settings I/O; the FIFO settings worker requests only the required RegisterHotKey or UnregisterHotKey phase on the GUI thread. Page, session, and close invalidation mark revocation first and drain queued GUI calls before waiting, so GUI and worker never wait on each other or use timeout as recovery. Revocation skips only the obsolete current-session hotkey side effect: every accepted config write still settles durably, its late completion follows the existing page/session drop rule, and a later session registers the saved policy. Enabling in a live session persists only after registration succeeds, and disk failure restores the previous registration. A same-value policy performs no write and emits no S02.

A known static conflict may be saved with KNOWN_CONFLICT warning. QWebChannel admission never waits for settings I/O; the FIFO settings worker requests only the required native replacement phase on the GUI thread. Page, session, and close invalidation skip obsolete native work before synchronous settings settlement but still persist the accepted hotkey value; the next session registers it. An actual RegisterHotKey failure in a live session preserves the previous working registration and setting.

The 1-60 minute value remains validated when disabled. Native GetLastInputInfo and the host timer remain the authority. By D19 this policy controls only idle timeout; Windows suspend always locks an unlocked session even when enabled is false.
Disconnected generator changes remain page-local as specified; only an unlocked session may persist defaults.

conditional_rules: newPassword and confirmPassword must match exactly
an explicitly empty new password is supported
newPassword may equal currentPassword and is not rejected as a synthetic no-op
D5 currentPassword verification occurs before any re-encryption write
AUTH_FAILED clears only currentPassword while preserving newPassword and confirmPassword
CHANGE_KEY_FAILED_UNCHANGED keeps the old session, dialog, and all three fields for a bounded retry

CANCELLED is emitted only before the commit boundary after the open transaction has been rolled back and native code has verified that the working file still opens with the old password and has not changed

CHANGE_KEY_FAILED_RESTORED is emitted only after an independent copy of the encrypted snapshot has replaced the working file and the old database has been reopened with the old password and passed salt and integrity verification; the original encrypted snapshot remains available through verification, then native SESSION_INVALIDATED cleanup clears all three fields and requires the old password to reconnect

CHANGE_KEY_RECOVERY_FAILED is non-retryable in the renderer, invalidates the session, preserves the encrypted snapshot natively, and enters a fail-closed native presentation without exposing its path or backend details

after the core re-encryption operation begins, every backend/database failure is normalized to CHANGE_KEY_FAILED_UNCHANGED, CHANGE_KEY_FAILED_RESTORED, or CHANGE_KEY_RECOVERY_FAILED according to the verified final database state; DATABASE_IO_FAILED or INTERNAL_FAILURE may only describe a pre-operation request-boundary failure
after the commit boundary cancellation is TOO_LATE
success alone uses change_key_success, revokes the session, force-clears native sensitive state, and requires the new password to reconnect
S01 uses distinct CHANGE_KEY_SUCCESS, CHANGE_KEY_RESTORED, and CHANGE_KEY_RECOVERY_FAILED reasons so no failed branch can masquerade as success

signals.name: sessionStateChangedV1
signals.notes: LOCKING is emitted only after native request admission has been closed. JavaScript clearing is supplementary; LOCKED is emitted after synchronous native cleanup. AUTO_LOCK is the idle-timeout reason; SUSPEND_LOCK is the D19 Windows sleep reason and never depends on C47 enabled/minutes.

signals.name: settingsChangedV1
signals.notes: S02 emits one complete public SettingsSnapshot and its opaque content-equality settingsRevision after a successful config commit, cross-process local-authority reconciliation, or QuickBar registration lifecycle change. A request matching the current local public authority emits no S02; S05 and stale or late results do not change this revision. No configuration path or unknown key is exposed.

signals.name: clipboardStateChangedV1
signals.notes: The signal never reads or returns clipboard text.

signals.name: requestProgressV1
signals.notes: No platform, account, path, password, exception, or backend message may appear in progress.

signals.name: systemThemeChangedV1
signals.notes: S05 reports only a system effective-theme change. It is not a config commit, does not change settingsRevision, and does not emit S02.

signals.name: dataRevisionChangedV1
signals.notes: A revision change invalidates stale summaries; it does not push changed records or secrets.

signals.name: updateStateChangedV1

host_operations.name: fixedWindowChrome
host_operations.inputs: Win32 non-client hit testing and fixed DOM button geometry only
host_operations.notes: Minimize, maximize, restore, drag, resize, and close remain the M2.2 native path. Close reads the native C43 preference: normal EXIT enters H06 without confirmation, while TO_TRAY delegates to H02. If H02 cannot establish a visible recoverable tray entry or cannot hide successfully, H01 keeps or restores the window and opens the D18 fixed localized native Exit/Cancel modal; renderer strings or generic QWebChannel actions are never accepted.

host_operations.name: trayLifecycle
host_operations.inputs: Fixed tray show and exit intents
host_operations.notes: Tray restore preserves the current authorized session, and tray Exit enters H06 without confirmation. TO_TRAY may hide the main window only after the native host confirms a visible recoverable tray entry. If tray availability, icon visibility, or hiding fails, H02 keeps or restores the window/session and uses the D18 native modal; Cancel, Escape, modal close, Alt+F4, or modal-construction failure preserve the setting and never enter H06, while explicit Exit does.

host_operations.name: globalHotkey
host_operations.inputs: WM_HOTKEY for one validated registered chord
host_operations.notes: The hotkey emits one fixed native QuickBar intent and is ignored without an unlocked session.

host_operations.name: autoLockMonitor
host_operations.notes: The renderer cannot reset, postpone, or certify the auto-lock timer. An untrusted or failed GetLastInputInfo sample cannot be treated as fresh user activity. D19 suspend locking is a separate native trigger and cannot be disabled through C47.

host_operations.name: clipboardTimer
host_operations.inputs: Native clipboard ownership fingerprint and validated clipboard policy
host_operations.notes: Countdown clearing protects user replacement content; security boundaries call force-clear separately.

host_operations.name: synchronousSecurityCleanup
host_operations.inputs: Manual lock, idle auto lock, D19 Windows suspend lock, switch, change-key success, renderer failure, or exit
host_operations.notes: Reject requests, stop activity, conceal and clear sensitive UI and leases, force-clear clipboard, disconnect, and destroy keys synchronously. Normal EXIT, tray Exit, and explicit Exit from the D18 TO_TRAY-failure modal may enter this operation; D18 cancellation and successful TO_TRAY must not. JavaScript, renderer acknowledgement, animation, or beforeunload is never an admission or completion dependency.

host_operations.name: rendererAndPowerLifecycle
host_operations.inputs: Qt renderer termination status and Windows power notifications
host_operations.notes: M3.5 implements the full recovery and diagnostic policy. M3.2 reserves no renderer-controlled recovery or DevTools command. By D19 a suspend notification locks immediately; a resume notification first installs an opaque native cover and completes any missing or interrupted lock before renderer presentation.

host_operations.name: encryptionAndDataAuthority
host_operations.notes: Database, encryption, uniqueness, strength, duplicate groups, health, TOTP, backup, and persistence never move into JavaScript.

host_operations.name: firstUseAgreement
host_operations.inputs: 当前语言及用户明确选择继续使用或退出
host_operations.notes: 主界面和托盘创建前显示随包双语软件许可告知，并允许切换语言。继续使用时尽力保存本机阅读记录；保存失败仍可继续，后续启动可以再次告知。退出则停止启动；密码库认证和安全生命周期不变。

host_operations.name: directTransferSession
host_operations.inputs: 当前主窗口授权及本次固定传输意图；接收完整资料仅由原生通道交付
host_operations.notes: pdmTransferLauncherV1只开放设备传输入口；独立pdmDirectTransferV1以原生flowId和借用会话处理开始、设备选择、本地8位配对码提交、接收端一次允许、发送、取消及重新开始。submitPairingCodeV1只收本次码字符串，approvePeerV1只提交接收端允许意图，sendV1同时带ALL/PASSWORDS/NOTES范围；没有旧confirmSas/prepare/acceptReceive入口。pairingCode只在接收WAITING投影，退出、认证成功或撤权即清；网页不接正文、密钥、程序路径或任意网络能力。候选认证与用户批准分开，SRP及HPKE通道绑定成功且接收端允许后才能交换库名与资料；错误候选不结束接收等待，升格后拒绝或断线结束本轮。authorizeNetworkV1/revokeNetworkV1保持原固定EXE、本地子网和Windows系统确认；connectAddressV1仅查询原生复核的当前子网IPv4，保原发现截止及254个唯一定向目标，广播每2秒。局域网v1查询、新版v2应答；旧v1应答仅提示升级不降级。localAddresses的网卡元信息只用于显示。完整接收校验后移交比较，只有start至完整校验期间保活，WTS/睡眠及安全离开撤销；日常和比较阶段不监听。精确协议及候选上限见docs/architecture/direct_transfer_protocol.md，原生所有权见秘密生命周期。

frontend_operations.name: presentationNavigationAndModalState

frontend_operations.name: vaultFilterAndLayoutState

frontend_operations.name: localFormAndVisibilityState

frontend_operations.name: dangerousConfirmationPresentation
frontend_operations.notes: The renderer presents D3/D4 confirmation, while the two-step delete ticket enforces it at the authority boundary. For D4 specifically, the confirmation opens without a ticket and its explicit dangerous action immediately chains C17 to C18.

frontend_operations.name: healthGuidanceState
frontend_operations.notes: Queue index, skip, resume banner, and navigation are bounded presentation state built from issue IDs and revisions.

frontend_operations.name: settingsControlPresentation
frontend_operations.notes: Segments, toggles, sliders, and hotkey recording are local controls; persistence and native effects require their specific typed methods.

frontend_operations.name: themeLanguageAndAccessibilityRendering

frontend_operations.name: backupConflictPresentation
frontend_operations.notes: Pagination, decision controls, and explicit password reveal consume preview and lease IDs; decrypted backup collections never enter JavaScript.

frontend_operations.name: quickbarFixtureRetired

frontend_operations.name: offlineHelpPresentation
